run_ter_scorer: run the TER scorer on hypothesis and reference translations to compute translation error rate
create_ter_scorer_instance: create a TERScorer instance with corpus_level scoring and multiprocess averaging
score_hypothesis_references: score a list of hypothesis translations against multiple reference translations using TER
register_ter_scorer: register the TER scorer with vizseq scorer registry under the id 'ter'
get_sentence_ter: get per-sentence TER scores by joining references and computing translation error rate
